description:
Intended for students graduating with their Bachelor’s degree by, or have graduated within, 12 months of cohort start date in February 2027.  Target Start Date: Feb 2027. Location: Nashville, TN. 
 
 Visa sponsorship is not available for this role. For clarity purposes, this means that Oracle is not in a position now, or in the future, to offer US immigration sponsorship. This includes, but is not limited to, support of H-1B, TN, O-1, green card or F-1 e.g. EAD, OPT, CPT, I-20, F-1 visa stamp, etc. 
 
 The Program:   
 Our future success depends on hiring world-class, early in career talent who are looking to power next-generation services and solutions. We are hiring students with a diverse set of skills and experiences to work in and across teams. Our program is intended to enhance your overall learning experience, help build your network, and accelerate your opportunity to make an impact.
  
 The Team: 
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is building some of the world's largest and most advanced GPU clusters and OCI solutions to power the next generation of AI. The Strategic Customer Engineering (SCE) team provides white-glove engineering, solutions, pre-sales, and operational support to OCI's most strategic AI/ML infrastructure customers.
 
As a trusted partner to our customers, SCE supports the discovery, design, deployment, operation, and optimization of infrastructure for demanding GPU and AI/ML environments. We work closely with customers and internal engineering teams to improve reliability, performance, and scalability for mission-critical AI workloads.
 
As a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) 1, you will assist with customer solutions, pre-sales discovery and solutions development, infrastructure deployment, monitoring, incident response, and automation. You will complete defined assignments under the guidance and review of experienced engineers, building practical skills in OCI, site reliability, and AI infrastructure.
 

 Key Responsibilities 
  
 Capacity Ingestion and Management: 
 Participate in infrastructure design discussions, document customer requirements and capacity needs, and follow established architecture, security, and operational standards.
 Assist customers and partners with onboarding, integration, and configuration of OCI solutions using established processes and best practices.
 Support capacity planning, provisioning, deployment, and validation of GPU, HPC, and AI infrastructure using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Slurm, and Kubernetes.
 Collaborate with experienced engineers to configure, test, and deploy infrastructure supporting HPC, AI, large language models (LLMs), agentic AI, and robotics workloads, including prototypes and performance testing.
  
 Incident and Service Lifecycle Management: 
 Monitor infrastructure and service health, gather metrics and logs, and investigate routine performance, connectivity, reliability, and availability issues using monitoring tools and runbooks.
 Assist with incident triage by collecting diagnostic information, documenting customer impact, and directing or escalating issues to the appropriate teams promptly.
 Support software upgrades, security patches, system maintenance, and infrastructure provisioning following established procedures.
  
 Automation 
 Develop, test, and maintain basic scripts using Python, Go, or Bash to automate routine infrastructure and operational tasks.
 Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation with guidance from experienced engineers.
  
 AI Infra Pre-Sales 
 Collaborate with engineers to support customer technical discussions, troubleshoot issues, and assist with OCI solution deployments.
 Work with engineering teams to test new features, document technical solutions, and share customer feedback.
  
 Learning and Development 
Build knowledge of cloud, site reliability, AI, GPU, HPC, and infrastructure technologies through training, hands-on assignments, mentoring, and guided use of new tools.
 
  
 What You’ll Bring: 
To be considered for a SRE position in OCI, you must possess the Objective Minimum Qualifications (OMQs) below. Please ensure that your application clearly indicates that you meet these OMQs, either on your resume, application questions, and/or by uploading additional documents such as a transcript. 
 Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Management Information Systems (MIS) or related field by February 2027.
 Visa sponsorship is not available for this role. For clarity purposes, this means that Oracle is not in a position now, or in the future, to offer US immigration sponsorship. This includes, but is not limited to, support of H-1B, TN, O-1, green card or F-1 e.g. EAD, OPT, CPT, I-20, F-1 visa stamp, etc.
 Interested in programming, cloud technology, servers, and data centers
 Proficient (able to complete coding tasks without assistance) in Go, Python, or Bash
 Demonstrated experience (projects, internships, coursework, research) with three or more of the following areas: Automation and scripting
 Computing workload testing and/or troubleshooting
 Configuration, testing, or deployment of LLM applications, AI systems, or robotics workloads
 Technical documentation and version control
 GPUs and/or HPC
 Agile or Scrum
 Terraform, Ansible, Slurm, or Kubernetes
 
 Completed at least one internship, research assistantship, teaching assistantship, or equivalent practical experience working with the relevant areas noted above. 
 Reside in the United States and/or attend a university in the US.
  
 Preferred Qualification: 
 Minimum 3.0 GPA
 
  


Disclaimer:

 Certain U.S. based or U.S. customer or client-facing roles may be required to comply with applicable requirements, such as immunization/occupational health mandates, and/or drug testing requirements. 

 Range and benefit information provided in this posting are specific to the stated locations only 

US: Hiring Range in USD from: $59,100 to $118,200 per annum. May be eligible for bonus and equity.


Oracle maintains broad salary ranges for its roles in order to account for variations in knowledge, skills, experience, market conditions and locations, as well as reflect Oracle's differing products, industries and lines of business.
Candidates are typically placed into the range based on the preceding factors as well as internal peer equity.

Oracle US offers a comprehensive benefits package which includes the following:
1. Medical, dental, and vision insurance, including expert medical opinion
2. Short term disability and long term disability
3. Life insurance and AD&D
4. Supplemental life insurance (Employee/Spouse/Child)
5. Health care and dependent care Flexible Spending Accounts
6. Pre-tax commuter and parking benefits
7. 401(k) Savings and Investment Plan with company match
8. Paid time off: Flexible Vacation is provided to all eligible employees assigned to a salaried (non-overtime eligible) position. Accrued Vacation is provided to all other employees eligible for vacation benefits. For employees working at least 35 hours per week, the vacation accrual rate is 13 days annually for the first three years of employment and 18 days annually for subsequent years of employment. Vacation accrual is prorated for employees working between 20 and 34 hours per week. Employees working fewer than 20 hours per week are not eligible for vacation.
9. 11 paid holidays
10. Paid sick leave: 72 hours of paid sick leave upon date of hire. Refreshes each calendar year. Unused balance will carry over each year up to a maximum cap of 112 hours.
11. Paid parental leave
12. Adoption assistance
13. Employee Stock Purchase Plan
14. Financial planning and group legal
15. Voluntary benefits including auto, homeowner and pet insurance

The role will generally accept applications for at least three calendar days from the posting date or as long as the job remains posted.
As part of Oracle's onboarding process and consistent with applicable law, US-based employees are required to complete identity verification, which involves the collection and processing of their biometric information. Accommodations to this requirement may be granted following an individualized assessment.

 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

 True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.

 We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

 Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.
